sources.name: Nimbus Cement Facility Master (nimbus_cement_plants.csv)
sources.used_for: Revenue, gross block, output, capacity, employees, water source, coastal flag, clinker flows
sources.label: Real
sources.notes: Fictional listed Indian cement company dataset provided for assessment; zero values altered.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 Reanalysis)
sources.used_for: Observed baseline (2005–2024) daily Tmax ≥40°C, ≥45°C, Rx1day, and ≥64.5 mm heavy rain days for all 9 plants
sources.label: Real
sources.notes: Direct batched API pull for all 9 plant coordinates in Asia/Kolkata timezone.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Climate Change API (CMIP6 HighResMIP)
sources.used_for: Delta-change future projections (observed ERA5 baseline + model future minus model baseline) for Heat & Extreme Rain
sources.label: Modelled
sources.notes: Direct API pull for all 9 plant coordinates (P01–P09) across 4 HighResMIP models. SSP2-4.5 & SSP1-2.6 scaled via IPCC AR6 warming ratios (A11).

sources.name: Open-Meteo Flood API (GloFAS v4)
sources.used_for: Baseline 1-in-25-year river discharge (m³/s) for river/canal plants P03 (Wardha), P06 (Mahanadi canal), P09 (Damodar)
sources.label: Real
sources.notes: Future discharge ratio scaled from site-level CMIP6 Rx1day change; coarse grid flat-terrain caveat applies.

sources.name: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 Water Risk Atlas
sources.used_for: Baseline, 2030, and 2050 baseline water stress (BWS) index; 2040 linearly interpolated
sources.label: Modelled
sources.notes: Basin-level context qualified by plant water_source; P07 uses desalinated seawater (decoupled from freshwater stress).

sources.name: NOAA IBTrACS v04r01 (North Indian Ocean)
sources.resolution: Exact storm track points within 200 km radius
sources.used_for: Historical tropical cyclone tracks per decade within 200 km for coastal plants P07 (Mundra: 24 storms / 5.3 per decade) and P08 (Paradip: 101 storms / 22.4 per decade)
sources.label: Real
sources.notes: Historical observed track frequency only; future cyclone frequency is not projected (Assumption A10).
